🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 22, 2026

Moon, in Aquarius, holds a sextile to Saturn, in its fall in Aries. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. Moon sextiles you from Aquarius: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal fire: beginning costs almost nothing. It has stood three weeks; by now the cost is known.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Aquarius, and the cost objects. Fixed earth: the grip is the expense. Venus left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Libra untitled. From Aquarius, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. Mercury has been out of Virgo for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you and passes through Aquarius as a guest. Mercury squares you from Libra: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. Jupiter let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, is only passing through Virgo. From Aquarius, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Fire that holds on, charged for holding. After three weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Libra. Sun crosses your sign: nothing you hold is seen from a distance. Mutable earth: the alternatives turn out identical. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Aquarius, meeting no resistance. Air that starts things, started cheaply. What pressed four weeks ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. Moon squares you from Aquarius, and something has to give way. Water holds on, and the holding is billed. The hold Saturn had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you from Leo, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. From Aquarius, Moon hands you an opening. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. From Virgo, Sun concedes the point early. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. Two weeks ago Saturn was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon is with you, close enough to read the small print. Fixed air: what is kept and who keeps it merge. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Across from you in Virgo, Sun holds the other half of the account. Water adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. Seven days ago none of this was in place.
